name: Onuma Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of the Onuma and Konuma lakes formed by the Komagatake eruption, with 126 islets linked by bridges and bicycle paths under Mt. Komagatake.
notes: Managed by Hokkaido. Onuma is a classic half-day stop on the Hokuto line from Hakodate.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
